outline:
現代通訊與訊號處理系統仰賴電路、硬體與軟體之間的協同運作，因此通訊工程師應具備必要的軟體設計的能力。本課程以建立此項核心能力為目標，並以C++為語言主要教學語言。學生須於課後投入約150~200小時完成一個通訊軟體設計專題。
本課程涵蓋下列主題：
1	通訊軟體特性
2	程序式程式設計
3	物件式程式設計
4	物件導向式程式設計
5	泛型式程式設計：使用C++ 標準模板函式庫(STL)
6	單元測試
7	通訊軟體函式庫
8	通訊軟體設計個案研
9	通訊軟體設計專題
schedule:
Week1~4
Part I: The basics:
Types, variables, strings, console I/O, computations, errors, vectors functions, source files, classes

Week5~6
Part II: Input and Output Programming
File I/O, I/O streams
Graphical output
Graphical User Interface (GUI) Programming)
Week7~10
Part III: Data structures and algorithms
Free store, pointers, and arrays
Lists, maps, sorting and searching, vectors, templates
The STL

Week11~13
Part IV: Software Engineering Issues
Software testing and maintenance
UML modeling for Object-Oriented Programming
Introduction to Design Patterns

Week14~18
Part V: Mobile and Multimedia Communication Software Design
Multimedia Communication Application Design
Mobile Communication software design, such Android Framework programming
assessment:
Homework Assignments: 60%, 6-8 Assignments
Mid-term Exam or Project: 20%
Final Project: 20%
